_comment: Deployment channels every client can point at. Each channel records TWO different things, and keeping them apart is the whole point: url is where that channel lives, and lastVerified is what that channel was last PROVEN to be serving (written by CD after a deploy passes its checks, null until then). lastVerified is a RECORD, never a requirement: production legitimately lags behind your working tree while you develop the next version. What this checkout builds lives in packages/contract/contract.lock.json, in exactly one place.

local.description: A hub on your own machine (npm run dev:hub). Plaintext is allowed here and nowhere else.

dev.description: Redeployed on every push to main, no gate. There is always something live and newer than the last release.

prerelease.description: The App Service staging slot, deployed on a version tag and fully verified. What production is about to become.

production.description: The production slot. Reached by a slot swap from prerelease, after an approval.
